title: Generating Dicke State Graphs
summary: Graph theory is a powerful tool in quantum computing, with applications ranging from quantum circuit synthesis and optimization to entanglement mapping. Recent work has shown how one can use edge-colored graphs to model photonic experiments that generate GHZ and W states. However, the latter work also proved that verifying that a graph models a Dicke state experiment is coNP-complete. In this work, we provide families of graphs that generate $|D_{k}^a\rangle \otimes |0\rangle^{\otimes b }$, where $b = |a-2k|$ is the number of spectator modes.
